title.purpose: The maibot wordmark in the header.

body.purpose: Supporting line under the heading, in Quiet Grey.

atmosphere.name: blurple-haze
atmosphere.purpose: Fixed, 28rem tall, across the top of the viewport.

focus.name: focus-ring-discord
focus.purpose: Focus on the Discord button; 2px white/80 ring with a 2px offset in the surface color.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Single entrance on the main container; none under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: pending-spin
motion.purpose: Pending spinner on the Discord button; static under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Card frame appears at and above; full-bleed below.

components.name: Discord Login Button
components.description: The one blurple action that starts Discord sign-in.
components.css: .ds-btn-discord { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #5865F2; color: #fff; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-discord:hover { background: #4752C4; } .ds-btn-discord:active { background: #3C45A5; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-discord:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2b2d31, 0 0 0 4px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); }

components.name: Raised Card
components.description: The single lifted container on desktop; full-bleed below 640px.
components.html:
Sign in to maibot

View your maimai DX scores, rating and B50.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 100%; max-width: 420px; padding: 40px; background: #2b2d31; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border: 1px solid #3f4147; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.333; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card-body { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.625; color: #b5bac1; }

components.name: Error Banner
components.description: Inline error status with a Phosphor warning-circle icon and recovery copy.
components.html: Couldn't sign in with Discord. Try again in a moment.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-banner p { margin: 0; } .ds-banner-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-banner-error { border-color: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216 / 0.3); background: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.885 0.062 18.334); }

components.name: Warning Banner
components.description: Inline warning status (e.g. account not linked) with a Phosphor link-break icon and an inline mono command.
components.css: .ds-banner-w { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.828 0.189 84.429 / 0.3); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(0.828 0.189 84.429 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.962 0.059 95.617); font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-banner-w p { margin: 0; } .ds-banner-w-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-cmd { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(0.879 0.169 91.605 / 0.15); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.9em; }

narrative.overview:
maibot lives inside the player's Discord habit, so the web side borrows Discord's own dark surfaces rather than shadcn's neutral greys: a near-black, faintly blue ground, one slightly lighter raised card, hairline borders, and Discord's blurple held back for the single action that leaves for Discord. The bar is the finish of Discord's own login screen, not a dashboard template.

Density is low and the voice is quiet. A surface shows a small wordmark, a direct heading, one supporting line, and the action. Status is spoken in tinted inline banners that say what happened and what to do next. Copy is English, sentence case.

Motion is a single entrance: the main container fades in and rises 8px over 500ms with ease-out, and does nothing when reduced motion is requested.
keyCharacteristics: Cool Discord darks (blue-tinted near-black ground, lighter card, hairline border).
Blurple reserved for the Discord action; elsewhere only as faint atmosphere.
One raised card on desktop that dissolves to full-bleed content on small screens.
Tinted inline status banners with a Phosphor icon and recovery copy.

rules.name: The One Blurple Rule
rules.body: Blurple at full strength fills only the Discord action. Elsewhere it appears only as atmosphere: a radial haze at 14% opacity across the top 28rem of the viewport, and text selection at 40%.

rules.name: The Discord Darks Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces use the cool Discord values (ground, card, hairline, quiet grey), never shadcn's stock neutral dark greys. The overrides go on an inner wrapper inside the `.dark` element, because the unlayered `.dark` rule beats utilities placed on the same element.

rules.name: The Literal Command Rule
rules.body: A bot command the player must type is set in JetBrains Mono inside a small tinted chip; prose around it stays in the sans.

dos: Do set dark surfaces on Discord Ground with one Raised Card and a Hairline border.
Do keep blurple fill for the Discord action, with hover and active steps from the palette.
Do put status in a tinted inline banner with a Phosphor icon and recovery copy.
Do set bot commands in JetBrains Mono inside a small tinted chip.
Do use the single fade-and-rise entrance (8px, 500ms, ease-out) and turn it off for reduced motion.
Do drop the card frame below 640px and let content sit full-bleed.
donts: Don't use shadcn's stock neutral dark greys on a maibot surface; use the Discord darks.
Don't spend blurple on headings, links, borders, or secondary buttons.
Don't use an official SEGA / maimai look.
